name: Kurana Munefuyu
source:
Yurika's butler. Possesses extraordinary fencing skills, but his flawed tea making skills are often the butt of his mistress's jokes. He is extremely popular with women, but his steadfastness and unwavering loyalty to Yurika make him look nigh impregnable. 

[spoiler]His hadan makes everything within a specific radius of him light as a feather, allowing him to casually dodge attacks with style as well as easily launch his own.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]He is in love with his mistress, Yurika. However, due to his self-loathing as well as other personal circumstances, he was not able to confess his love nor fulfill her dream.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]Munefuyu was one of the top students in the first Senshinkan. The horrifying events that marked the academy's downfall traumatized him. As a promise to the friends and classmates he had done awful things to, he gave up on using his left hand in combat.[/spoiler]
